label: Toga system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a single-protein Toga antiviral locus that is encoded by P4-like phage satellites and can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Single-protein P4-associated phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Toga protein products, P4/P2 mobile elements, candidate protein domains, source assay rows, and unresolved or missing DefenseFinder HMM/rule rows.
